image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent T-Rex from the config library mid-stumble on the racetrack. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Forest-green pebbled skin, charcoal spine plates, sulfur-yellow underbelly, and tiny two-fingered hands. ACTION: A massive, high-impact trip. One huge three-toed foot has hooked a prehistoric log, sending his enormous upper body pitching violently forward. His weight is centered over his nose as he begins to face-plant. HANDS: His tiny arms are flailing comically and uselessly, far too short to break his fall. FACIAL EXPRESSION: A hilarious look of pure, bug-eyed terror. His jaw is dropped wide open in a silent scream, and his tongue is flying upward. TAIL: His thick, heavy tail is whipped high into the air behind him, vertical and shaky. SETTING: The prehistoric dirt track with a massive, explosive cloud of dust and flying turf around the tripping foot. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3' with extreme physical comedy. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'.
